name: project_run
title: Run Project Task
description: Runs one project-declared task, test suite, or lint pass on a client (action is required: task, test, or lint; never free-form commands). Discover runnable tasks with project_inspect first. For arbitrary commands use shell_exec instead. Long runs may outlive the window, then poll job_get for the result. Unlisted name: inspect via project_inspect first, never free-form. REQUIRED: 1. pick task/test/lint 2. run, poll. IF TEST_UNAVAILABLE: add runner config. DO NOT freestyle; declared tasks only.

client_id.description: Target NC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

path.description: Project root on the selected client, under allowed roots.

task.description: Declared task name. Required when action is task.

runner.description: Explicit runner when ambiguous (npm, make, just, composer, pytest, ruff, mypy).
Explicit runner when ambiguous (npm, make, just, composer, pytest, ruff, mypy).
Explicit runner when ambiguous (npm, make, just, composer, pytest, ruff, mypy).

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id (null when no host was targeted).

job_id.description: Server job handle for this execution.

resource_uri.description: Offload pointer for a large result text (nc://jobs/<jobId>/output). Present only when the envelope text was offloaded; fetch the full text with result_fetch.

resource_link.description: Programmatic offload reference (mcp:result_fetch:<jobId>). Present only when the envelope text was offloaded.

resource_bytes.description: Byte size of the offloaded result text. Present only when the envelope text was offloaded.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

result.description: Run receipt: platform, runner output and truncation flags.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.

execution_state.description: Live lifecycle state when the call outlived the sync window (running, queued, ...); null otherwise.

error.description: Structured failure detail. Present when status is failed.

category.description: Public error category for model branching. invalid_argument: Fix the input; do not retry the same call unchanged. authentication: Re-authenticate before retrying. authorization: Insufficient permission; do not retry or attempt to bypass. policy: Rejected by host policy; do not attempt to bypass. Adjust the request or ask an operator. not_found: Resource missing; re-discover the id/path/service/container before retrying. conflict: Conflicting state; re-read the current state, then decide. unsupported: Not supported here; do not retry. Look for an alternative tool or capability. timeout: Timed out; if retryable, wait, then poll with job_get. transient: Transient; retry with backoff if retryable. execution: Execution failure; inspect stdout/stderr/state before retrying. cancelled: Cancelled; do not blindly retry. internal: Internal error; if it reproduces, report it with nc_feedback.

retryable.description: Whether retrying may succeed (mirrors top-level retryable).

details.description: Curated safe context (never secrets, stacks, or internal paths).

warnings.description: Non-fatal advisory notes. Always present; empty when none.
